entries.FiveIsland_Text_BeenGettingBusierAroundH:
It's been getting busier around
these parts lately.

I haven't been catching many good
fish lately, either.
entries.FiveIsland_Text_IslandSign:
FIVE ISLAND
Chrono Island: Where Time Goes
entries.FiveIsland_Text_WeirdBuildingInMeadow:
Oh, this stinks. I wanted to play in
the MEADOW.

But they put up a weird building
on it, so I can't play there.

entries.FiveIsland_House1_Text_HusbandWentOffFis:
Don't worry about buying anything
for dinner tonight!

…That's what my husband said when
he went off fishing today.

I'm not sure if I can count on him
to live up to that promise.

entries.FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToF:
That MEADOW has belonged to our
family for generations.

I should have had a giant mansion
built on it.

It would be preferable to having
those thugs run wild on it!

entries.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonInt:
Aiyeeeeeh!

I thought this was an ancient ruin.
But it's teeming with ghosts!
entries.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonPos:
I'm trying to get out of here, but
I always end up at the same spot.

Maybe the number of boulders is
a hint…

entries.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraDefe:
If you don't go into the right
tunnel, you won't get ahead.
entries.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraIntr:
I think there is a mysterious power
at work in this cave.
entries.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraPost:
Earlier, a lady went into the caves
ahead.

entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordAn:
{PLAYER} entered a password.

“GOLDEEN need log.”

… …  … …  … …

Another password is needed to
open the door…
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordDo:
{PLAYER} entered two passwords.

“GOLDEEN need log.”
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”

… …  … …  … …

The WAREHOUSE's door opened!
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Intro:
This area's strictly off-limits!
Out, out!
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1PostBattle:
You don't have any business here!
Go home!
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Intro:
There's nothing past here except
our WAREHOUSE.

So what brings you here?
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2PostBattle:
You're wanting to know what's inside
this WAREHOUSE?

It's better you didn't know.
For your own sake, I mean.
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Intro:
You'd be wasting time even if you
were to get by me.
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3PostBattle:
You won't be able to get in without
the passwords anyway.
entries.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_WarehouseDoorAlre:
The WAREHOUSE's door is already
open.

entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToY:
Please be good to your POKéMON,
too.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro:
I'm the middle kid of the BIRD
BROTHERS.

The best thing about birds…
It has to be the wings.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostB:
There was a really somber guy
over that way.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveR:
If you don't have room for it,
I'll hold it for you till next time.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDef:
Down is so comfy…
It makes me drowsy…
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldInt:
I'm the youngest of the BIRD
BROTHERS.

The best thing about birds…
It has to be the down.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPos:
It fills me with happiness when
bird POKéMON beg playfully…
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesT:
Boulders and rocks are neatly piled
up as a cairn.

“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved
on a boulder.

“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved
on a boulder.

There is a LEMONADE placed as an
offering in front of the grave.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnot:
Would you like to leave another
LEMONADE as an offering?
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro:
I'm the eldest of the BIRD
BROTHERS.

The best thing about birds…
It has to be the beak.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostB:
You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from
here.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCan:
{PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE
in front of the grave.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHave:
Oh, it's you from that time…

I still have that thing I wanted
you to have as my thanks.
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouP:
Th-thank you…

That was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…

I don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…

It's uplifted me a little.

Can you please take this as my
thanks?
entries.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhe:
This is where I buried my ONIX…
It was named TECTONIX…

entries.FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnMyWay:
I'm on my way to prepare a meal
for a certain high-society person.
entries.FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoureOn:
You're on a quest to catch every
single kind of POKéMON?

…How incredible. Please tell me if
you catch a strong one!

entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDef:
This loss…
I feel like I'm whiting out…
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaInt:
Excuse me!
I'm trying to paint.
Please keep out of my sight!
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPos:
GILLIAN?
Please tilt your head slightly…
There! That's the look I want!
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyDefe:
The shame of this…
I'm red-faced…
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntr:
With these hands, I will create
my victory!
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPost:
Uh-oh, my paint tubes have
scattered everywhere!
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinInt:
I'm a good runner.
I'm really fast!
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPos:
When I run with the wind, it feels
like I could fly!
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIn:
I'm thinking of having a pool
made specially for POKéMON.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPo:
A pool would be nice, but I must
say, a sun-room may be sublime.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntr:
I am visiting my friend's retreat,
if you must know.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPost:
I find it pleasurable to leisurely
battle in the gentle sea breeze.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaDefe:
Oh…
My feelings, they are blue…
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntr:
Hmm…
The angle, it is not quite there…
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPost:
The sky and the sea…
They are so fickle.

Their changing expressions make
them difficult to capture.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefea:
That's a shocker!
You must be joking.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro:
I say, this marine life here at
this resort agrees with me.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostB:
Getting so serious over this…
How nonsensical.

entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_But:
Butler: Your BAG appears to be
unfortunately full.

Butler: I shall do as you bid,
my lady.

Butler: I sincerely thank you for
pleasing Lady SELPHY.

Please accept this as her thanks…
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Lad:
Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY
has the brilliance of the sun.

Please, I beg you to bring joy
to Lady SELPHY.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Mon:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.

Oh, my gracious. That must be the
{STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.

Giggle…
I see a resemblance to you.

Thank you so kindly.

… …  … …  … …
Is something the matter?

You may leave.

… …  … …  … …
Oh, fine. I understand now.

SEBASTIAN!
I need you here this instant!
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhI:
SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this.
I'm tired of waiting for you.

I'll forgive you this time, but
please don't fail me next time.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Ple:
SELPHY: Oh?
Do I know you from somewhere?

Oh, but that doesn't matter.

I am exquisitely bored.
Please, hear my wish.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Sel:
SELPHY: See to it that this person
is given a token of appreciation.

SELPHY: I wish you the best of
luck.
entries.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Wis:
I wish to see a POKéMON.
A darling {STR_VAR_1}.

I want to see one right away.
Please, make my wish come true.

entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1In:
I don't know or care if what I'm
doing is right or wrong…

I just put my faith in GIOVANNI
and do as I am told.
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2De:
Urgh…
You were too strong…

…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!

So it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2In:
That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.

Spreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…

It's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.

Fortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a child!

And now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Po:
We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…

But don't think this is over.
I won't let this be the end.

I will find GIOVANNI.
And I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!
I will…

Until then, farewell!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GetLostL:
What do you want now?
Go on, get lost, leave me be.
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonIn:
I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…

Then, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!

Fufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Giovanni:
What, you again?

You… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?

No, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.

You don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1In:
Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.
You're willing to sell them?

Oh?
You wanted to battle?
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Po:
We can give you a great price.
Sell us your POKéMON!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2De: What do you think you're doing?!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2In:
Did you come here knowing it's
TEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Po:
TEAM ROCKET broke up?
What planet are you from?
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3In:
I got word about you from the
others.

But there's no way a kid like you'd
know our BOSS GIOVANNI!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Po:
Don't mess in the doings of adults,
you jumped-up pip-squeak!
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_MadeItSo:
I've made it so you can come back
in through there.

Why don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?

The ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.

You'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ManyMons:
There are many POKéMON locked
away in the pen…
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_PenUnloc:
The pen door is unlocked.
The POKéMON appear to have fled.
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ReportWi:
A report with graphs and text is on
the PC monitor.

“The Influence of Magnetic Waves
on POKéMON Evolution”…

… … … … … …

It's too difficult to understand…
entries.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonPo:
If I can't sell it, it's worthless!
Go ahead, take it!

entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefe:
Your POKéMON are growing up
admirably well!
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntr:
This is an excellent environment
for raising POKéMON.
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePost:
You know, I think you have the
talent to be a good BREEDER.
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRe:
Oh, hello.
That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.

Seeing it reminds me of a sweet 
little girl I met while traveling.

She was gently grooming POKéMON…
She was a little angel.

That little girl's name…
I think it was DAISY.
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveS:
…Unfortunately, you don't have
space for this in your party.

You'd better come back for it
another time.
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetS:
I received that EGG while I was
traveling.

I'm glad I met someone like you.
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_HmmISeeIs:
Ah, hmm…
I see, I see…
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTake:
You travel all over the place,
don't you?

You're not driving your POKéMON
too harshly, are you?

Let me take a look.
… … …   … … …
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_ReceivedE:
{PLAYER} received an EGG
from the man!
entries.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonR:
Oh, impressive.
You treat your POKéMON right.

I think you can be entrusted with
this.

Please, I'd like you to have this.

entries.FourIsland_Text_IslandSign:
FOUR ISLAND
The Warm, Blue, Floe Island
entries.FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasLotsOfStuffedD:
Oh, you found me!
Please don't tell LORELEI.

Did you know that LORELEI has lots
and lots of stuffed dolls?

Every time she comes back to
FOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!
entries.FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasReturned:
LORELEI has returned.

Did she find the city life too
stressful, I wonder?
entries.FourIsland_Text_LoreleiMetLaprasAsChild:
LORELEI has gone back.

The LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.

I believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.

Perhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.
entries.FourIsland_Text_MadeSlushieUsingIcefallC:
Ooh, chilly!

I made a slushie using ice I
shaved inside ICEFALL CAVE.

It's chilly and tasty!

entries.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ThankYo:
{PLAYER}, thank you.
But this is awful…

I was born and raised here on
these islands.

I had no idea that those horrible
criminals were loose here…

entries.FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IfAnything:
LORELEI: There's something weighing
heavily on my mind.

If anything were to happen on
the island where I was born…

I wouldn't know about it if I were
in the POKéMON LEAGUE.

I wonder if that would make me
irresponsible to my home…
entries.FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IllReturnT:
LORELEI: So, you managed to solve
all the problems here?

That's wonderful.

That means there isn't any reason
for me to be here all the time.

Thank you…

I'll return to the POKéMON LEAGUE
in a short while.
entries.FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_WillDoWhat:
I don't know what will happen in
the future, but…

I will do what I can here and now.
That's all I can do.

entries.FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm
region overall.

But there is one exception you
need to know about.

The ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because
of the POKéMON that live in it.
entries.FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThis:
We've had a great and powerful
TRAINER grow up on this island.

I bet even you'd know her.
It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!

When LORELEI was just a tyke,
I taught her about POKéMON.

entries.FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCare:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.

…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.

They said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.
entries.FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPoke:
What's this?

The new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't
arrived on this island?
entries.FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIce:
There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON
that lives in the cave.

We get a lot of visitors hoping to
see that POKéMON.
entries.Text_BodySlamTeach:
Ready?
Boing!

We're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.

If you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…

How about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?
entries.Text_BodySlamWhichMon:
Which POKéMON wants to learn how
to BODY SLAM?

entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro:
Do you know how caves form inside
volcanoes?
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle:
When lava at the surface of magma
hardens, and the magma inside flows
out, caverns are left behind.
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro:
You've been eavesdropping on us,
haven't you?
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Trying to horn in on our treasure?
Don't bet on it!
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
Develop amnesia conveniently and
forget everything you heard!
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat: I think I tried to overdo it…
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro:
I've been in training so I can mend
my broken heart…

It toughened me up physically at
least! Hi-yah!
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle:
The way you battle, it reminds me
of the guy who dumped me…
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat:
Whew… That was hot!
Sweat's erupting from me!
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro:
An active volcano is one that's
erupting, or about to.
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle:
They say there're over 1,500
active volcanoes in the world.

Just thinking about them makes me
feel all hot and gooey inside!
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontSte:
What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.

You! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!

If you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere:
Over here.
We'll try digging here.

That treasure the ADMINS've been
talking about should be here.
entries.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLo:
What the…?
You're in the way. Get lost.
entries.Text_ExplosionDeclined:
Yeah, you're right.
It is too terrifying.
entries.Text_ExplosionTaught:
Using EXPLOSION while on this
volcano…

What a terrifying thrill!
entries.Text_ExplosionTeach:
Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?

The explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?

While we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?
entries.Text_ExplosionWhichMon:
You're terribly brave!

Which POKéMON should I teach
EXPLOSION?

entries.OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithHoenn:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.

She said we finally have PC linkage
with people in HOENN.

I'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man.

He would make a fine husband for
my granddaughter!
entries.OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithKanto:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.

She said we now have PC linkage
with people in KANTO.

I'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!
entries.OneIsland_Text_IslandSign:
ONE ISLAND
Friends Gather at Knot Island
entries.OneIsland_Text_IsntWarmClimateHereGreat:
Hi, sight-seeing, are you?
Isn't the warm climate here great?
entries.OneIsland_Text_LuckyToHaveCelioHere:
Here we are on an island smack in
the middle of nowhere.

We're lucky to have an upstanding
young man like CELIO here.

My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over CELIO's friend.

Something about a famous
POKéMANIAC?

I'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!
entries.OneIsland_Text_PokemonNetCenterSign:
Expanding the POKéMON World!
POKéMON NET CENTER
entries.Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail:
Ahoy, there!
Where do you want to sail?

entries.OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnS:
On sunny days, I step out and gaze
upon the volcano.

That's my daily routine.
entries.OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberEru:
Let me think… When was the last
time MT. EMBER erupted?

entries.OneIsland_House2_Text_IWantToStayHereFor:
Young people all want to go off to
big cities.

But I want to stay here forever!

entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailIntro: I'm beginning to get a sunburn…
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailPostBat:
I like that cap you have.
Maybe I should wear one, too…
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceIntro:
You know, everything tastes great
when you're out in the wild.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BrycePostBattl:
The water in volcanic regions is
delicious.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireIntro:
My lunch filled us up, so will you
battle us for some exercise?
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClairePostBatt:
What should I do?
I feel famished again.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_EmberSpaSign:
Light the Fire in Your Heart!
EMBER SPA
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnIntro:
Seen from here, MT. EMBER towers
into the sky.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnPostBattle:
The sky is immense around these
parts.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettDefeat:
Hey, what the…
You're good, you!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettIntro:
I took a break from swimming,
only to have you challenge me?
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettPostBat:
Instead of using SURF all the time,
you should swim some.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughIntro:
Dress appropriately for battle!
Lose that frivolous outfit!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughPostBattle:
Even martial artists are becoming
fashion conscious these days…
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaDefeat:
KIA: Huh?!
I can't believe it!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaIntro:
KIA: My big brother and I make
an awesome combination!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaNotEnoughMo:
KIA: If you want to battle with
us, you have to bring at least two
POKéMON with you.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaPostBattle:
KIA: How could there be anyone
better than my big brother?
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaIntro:
The weather's gorgeous!
Perfect for a battle!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaPostBattl:
Please don't splash my face!
You'll ruin the makeup.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikIntro:
MIK: Together with KIA, I'm afraid
of nothing!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikNotEnoughMo:
MIK: Hey, do you want to battle
with us two?

Bring two or more POKéMON with
you, then.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikPostBattle:
MIK: How could my combination
with KIA fail?
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_RouteSign:
This is KINDLE ROAD.

Go straight for MT. EMBER.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonDefeat: You were a cut above me.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonIntro:
Could you help me out with my
training?
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonPostBatt:
It's clear that you're skilled.
I like you!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaIntro:
Every morning, before breakfast,
I swim around this island.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaPostBattle:
I lost because I'm pooped from all
the running I did…
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaIntro:
There isn't a day in which we don't
train!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaPostBattl: I'll train even harder from now on!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyIntro:
Wait! Wait a second!
I think I've hooked a big one!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyPostBattl:
Not only did I lose, the big one
got away from me, too!

entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Bruno:
After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in
the hot spring pool.

BRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.

He comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Enjoy:
My favorite part of bathing comes
up right after this.

I enjoy a bowl of chowder to
warm me from the inside, too!
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Expla:
That shatters boulders as if they
were made of crackers.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_HotSp:
Soaking in a hot spring pool is
therapeutic, people say.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_SeeHo:
Have a look at my face.
See how smooth my skin is?

The hot spring's water keeps my
skin younger than my age.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_UsedT:
Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.

The EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.

I hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.

I was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.
entries.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Water:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!

Aaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!

You should jump in, too.

Go to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!

entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AnotherG:
While I was studying gemstones,
I discovered something important.

There is another gem that forms
a pair with this RUBY.

That other gemstone is supposed to
be in the SEVII ISLANDS.

{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go
find the other gem.

{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry
PASS and the TOWN MAP?
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCant:
{PLAYER}, is there anything that
you can't stand?

Apparently, BILL simply can't
stomach milk at all.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsFir:
{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind
of POKéMON?

BILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves
every kind.

Apparently, the first one he caught
was an ABRA.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsHom:
By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from
PALLET TOWN, aren't you?

I've heard that it's a quiet and
pleasant place.

BILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,
where his folks still live.

I've heard that it's quite the
festive, bustling city.

I'd like to go there one day.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CameFrom:
Oh, you're a stranger here!
Hi! Where did you come from?

…PALLET TOWN?
I don't know it!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCau:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things
been for you?

Oh, is that right?
You've caught more POKéMON.

Do you know what?
Maybe I can be useful to you.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioHea:
CELIO: Hello!

{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors
about you.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioImM:
CELIO: Hello!
You look awfully busy as always.

How am I doing?

Well, I'm modifying my Network
Machine.

When I get done with the machine,
I hope you'll be first to use it,
{PLAYER}.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Enormous:
On this island, there's an enormous
volcano.

It hasn't erupted lately, so why
not enjoy a hike?
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GotPCWor:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!

Did you see?
We got the PC working!

I've got a few things to show
CELIO here.

Can you go out on a stroll or
something for a while more?
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HmmHowAb:
Hmm…

How about we try this like this…
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LinkedUp:
I did it!
I linked up with LANETTE!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineL:
Network Machine
Link Level 1

Link established with the KANTO
region.

Network Machine
Link Level 2

Link established with the KANTO
and HOENN regions.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineU:
Network Machine
Link Level 0

…POKéMON Storage System under
adjustment…
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManagedT:
{PLAYER}…
{PLAYER}, I did it!

I've managed to link up with
TRAINERS in the HOENN region!

Finally, the Network Machine is
fully operational!

{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!

Thanks to you, my dream came
true…
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MayIAskO:
Thank you!
{PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.

… … …  … … …

Um… May I ask one more giant favor
of you?
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeedsSpe:
But, there is a slight catch.

For the link to work, the Machine
needs a special gemstone.

It's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND,
but I haven't found one yet.

Who knows where it could be.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Obtained:
Obtained an extra page for the
TOWN MAP!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetY:
This is my own ferry PASS.

It will let you get to all the
SEVII ISLANDS.

{PLAYER}, please, I can't do
it without your help.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PleaseIN:
It… It's not anything weird.
Please, I need your help.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Returned:
{PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and
received the RAINBOW PASS.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SorryFor:
I'm sorry for taking up so much of
BILL's time.

I'm also sorry for being such a 
poor host on your visit here.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankYou:
CELIO: So this is the gem that
forms a pair with the RUBY…

{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot
to get this, didn't you?

You don't have to tell me. I know
it wasn't easy.

Thank you so much!

Now it's my turn to work for you!
Please give me a little time.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedWi:
I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend
far away!

Everyone's saying that we can
thank you and CELIO.

So, thank you!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryingTo:
I was trying to find the gem
even while I was studying.

As a result, I've made no headway
in both my search and studies…

If I relied on BILL, I'm sure my
research would progress.

But this time, I want to try to do
things by myself.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishICou:
I wish I could trade POKéMON with
my boyfriend who lives far away…
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishYouB:
I…
I'm not crying.

That's enough about me!

{PLAYER}, you're going to keep
looking for exotic POKéMON, right?

I wish you the best of luck!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullBeT:
I'm modifying the Network Machine
right now.

I'm changing it so it can handle
trades over long distances.

When I get finished, you'll be
trading for exotic POKéMON from
TRAINERS far away.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillBrin:
BILL: So, bring me up to speed.
How's your machine running?
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCatc:
BILL: I'll catch you later!
Say hi to the guy for me!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHows:
BILL: Well, absolutely!
How's your research coming along?

…Oh, wait a sec.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillLetM:
BILL: Oh, yeah?
Okay, let me take a look-see.

…Hang on here…
I think we can make it work.
Let me help you, okay?
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDe:
{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for
me just a bit?

…Actually, can I get you to do
me a favor?

The island next to this one's
called TWO ISLAND.

There's a guy there that runs
a GAME CORNER.

He has this thing for rare rocks
and gems.

We keep in touch, being fellow
maniacs.

So, can I get you to deliver this
METEORITE to him?
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCan:
CELIO: BILL!
I can't believe you came out here.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPCs:
CELIO: It's running fine, but we're
too remote out here.

The PCs on this island just can't
link with your PC, BILL.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPle:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going
to TWO ISLAND, please take this.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioTha:
CELIO: That's really impressive.

I hate to say it, but I have zero
aptitude for battling.

Anyways, I'm glad to meet you.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLets:
It's a PASS for the ferry service
serving the local islands.

It will let you travel between the
ISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.

Oh, you should have this, too.
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIs:
CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the
reigning POKéMON CHAMP!

CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising
contender as the POKéMON CHAMP!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Received:
{PLAYER} received an extra page
for the TOWN MAP!
entries.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThisIsMy:
{PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO.
He's one dedicated PC MANIAC!

entries.OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro:
Lying back, rocked by the waves…
It's exquisite.
entries.OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBa:
The sea is pleasantly warm in these
parts.
entries.OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsW:
Good things get washed up by the
ocean current onto this beach.

That's why I often come here for
some beachcombing.

entries.SevenIsland_Text_IslandSign:
SEVEN ISLAND
Quest Island of Infinity
entries.SevenIsland_Text_IslandVirtuallyUntouche:
This island has been left virtually
untouched in its natural state.

It could be a little difficult to
hike around because of that.
entries.SevenIsland_Text_IslandsMadeInSevenDays:
These islands are called the SEVII
ISLANDS because there are seven.

…Or at least that's what the young
people believe.

The truth is, these islands are so
named because they are said to
have been made in seven days.
entries.Text_SwordsDanceTaught:
If only we could keep getting
stronger and stronger, eh?
entries.Text_SwordsDanceTeach:
Not many people come out here.

If I train here, I'm convinced that
I'll get stronger and stronger.

Yep, stronger and stronger…

How would you like to learn a move
like that? It's SWORDS DANCE.
entries.Text_SwordsDanceWhichMon:
All right, pick which POKéMON
I should teach it to.

entries.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_ChallengeVi:
Ah!
Welcome, my friend!

Let me tell you something. There's
a hidden room in the basement.

A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is
waiting there now.

Tell me, you did come to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}, am I right?
entries.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DontHoldAny:
All right.
Don't hold anything back!
entries.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_LimitThreeM:
Ah!
You will battle for me?

It was worth my time moving the
box aside, then.

… …
But there is one slight problem.

This hidden room is not built very
sturdy.

Can I get you to limit it to
battles of three POKéMON per side?
entries.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OhYouWontBa:
Oh…
You won't battle…

I see, I see.
… …

Well, perhaps if you change your
mind, do come back.
entries.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OnlyEnjoyme:
I may not look like much now,
but when I was younger…

I flew everywhere, challenging
TRAINERS wherever I found them.

Now, my only source of enjoyment
is reminiscing about the past while
watching battles.
entries.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SaveProgres:
Fine! Before your battle, would
you like to save your game?
entries.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SlightBreez:
There is a slight breeze blowing
around the box.

entries.SevenIsland_Mart_Text_MonHavePersonaliti:
POKéMON have personalities of their
own, just like people.

My PIKACHU has a HASTY nature,
so it grew to be a speedy POKéMON.
entries.SevenIsland_Mart_Text_NeedToFishOnSevenI:
I need to fish on SEVEN ISLAND.

That will complete my fishing tour
of the SEVII ISLANDS.

I'd better stock up on some
POKé BALLS first, though.
entries.SevenIsland_Mart_Text_PreparationsComple:
Okay, preparations are complete
for me to explore the RUINS.

entries.SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CheckO:
If you're confident, you should
check out TRAINER TOWER.
entries.SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DidYou:
Did you ride a SEAGALLOP ferry
to get here?

There are at least ten of those
high-speed ships.

I don't know where they all go,
though.
entries.SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Events:
On this island, different events
occur depending on connections.

What are those connections?

They are for you to discover on
your own.

entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_BrunoTrai:
Training by oneself is certainly
not a bad thing.

But it's also not bad to aim for
the top with a partner.

Even BRUNO…
He trained with a fellow by the
name of BRAWLY before.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyPost:
The way I am now, I may have to
hold off on TRAINER TOWER…
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanIntro:
It doesn't matter if you happen to
have the strongest POKéMON…

It doesn't mean a thing if you don't
know how to use them properly!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanPostB:
You see them every so often,
TRAINERS with awesome POKéMON
who have no idea what to do.

Before training POKéMON, TRAINERS
themselves need to grow up.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonDe:
Whoa! You're tough!
How about protecting me?
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonIn:
I work to protect the environment.
In turn, nature protects me!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonPo:
From far out among the stars, our
planet is just a drop of water.

But we want to protect that drop
of water for everyone.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynDe:
You're hot stuff in spite of your
cute looks.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynIn:
Those shoes you have are pretty
snazzy.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynPo:
Your mom bought those snazzy
RUNNING SHOES for you?

She must adore you.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyDefe:
I knew it!
You're as tough as I thought!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyIntr:
You look strong.
Let me battle you, please!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyPost:
The way you battle has given me
a lot of useful data.

Thanks so much!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexDefeat:
LEX: I seem to have been too
careless…
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexIntro:
LEX: My darling NYA, together
we could win!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexNotEno:
LEX: May I ask you to battle the
both of us at the same time?
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexPostBa:
LEX: I think it was a good
experience for NYA.

You have my gratitude.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleD:
Thank you. I feel like I've been
set free by losing to you.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleI:
I was given the best possible
education to become this strong.

I don't want to lose to anyone!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleP:
For some reason, I get furious
over the slightest thing.

I'll calm myself by breathing
deeply.
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaDefeat:
NYA: Oh, no…
I'm so sorry, I…
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaIntro:
NYA: I'll do my best so I won't
drag down my mentor, LEX!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaNotEno:
NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle
in two-on-two style?
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaPostBa:
NYA: I think I'm going to need
much more seasoning and tutoring
under LEX…

…So, LEX, please, may I stay with
you like this?

entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_:
EVE: Me and JON, we lost.
Ehehe.

EVE: I'll team up with JON and
battle together.

EVE: I want to team up with JON
when I battle you.

Come back with two POKéMON, okay?

EVE: I'm going to work harder with
JON.

JON: When I'm with EVE,
it doesn't feel like I've lost!

JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels
like we could never lose.

JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be
happy to battle with you.

So, I'd like to make it a
two-on-two battle, if I may.

JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel
giddy whether I win or lose.

It's magical!

You don't seem to be a problem
TRAINER.

I punish people who abuse
POKéMON!

If you treat your POKéMON with
kindness, they'll understand.

Oh, so you're not a fan…

Well, I can change that.
Let me sing for you!

Howdy!
Are you a member of my fan club?

Lalalah…
My POKéMON, I send them out,
all the girls scream and shout!

Tch!
Too strong for me!

Kyahaha!
I'll flick you away effortlessly!

What's that?
I don't act the way I look?

Heh, that's a part of my strategy!
Uh-huh…

This island is too spread out…
It's not easy patrolling the place.

TRAINERS like you from cities,
they sure are tough.

You'll be headed for the TOWER,
won't you?

SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE

TRAINERS are asked to refrain from
damaging plants in the CANYON.

entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_Cha:
Dance, dance!
CHANSEY Dance!

You join in, too!
Dance, dance!
entries.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_You:
Ahahahaha!

There, you're all chipper now!
Lucky!

entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminDef: I'm not much good in battle.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminInt:
A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep
inside here.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminPos:
I hear there are other ruins like
the one here.

Might they be the resting places
of other mystic POKéMON?
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonDefe:
That was uncalled for.
You didn't have to be so rough.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonIntr:
Do you know anything about this
stone chamber?
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonPost:
The TANOBY RUINS date back at
least 1,500 years.

But it's a baffling mystery as to
why it was built in the first place.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordInt:
Today, in addition to our lesson,
we came to see the chamber.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordPos:
Ah, so you are studying POKéMON
on your own…

Yes, you certainly are quite the
extraordinary person, indeed.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaDefeat:
We might get in trouble for being
noisy here.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaIntro:
CLIFFORD is teaching me how to
paint.
entries.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaPostBat:
I said that I wanted to paint an
old building.

So CLIFFORD brought me here.

entries.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioPostB:
In your future, I sense that you
will meet many others.

I think you will be linked to each
other by a strange power.
entries.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteInt:
Somewhere on this island, peculiar
POKéMON are sleeping.
entries.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePos:
Somewhere on this island, peculiar
POKéMON are sleeping.

Could it be that they're waiting
for you?
entries.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTow:
TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE
Rise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!

entries.SixIsland_Text_IslandSign:
SIX ISLAND
Fortune Island of Aged Wisdom
entries.SixIsland_Text_SkyAtNightIsFantastic:
When you're this far away from the
city, the sky at night is fantastic.
entries.SixIsland_Text_ThatWayToWaterPathRuinVal:
Keep going this way and you'll get
to the WATER PATH.

Stay on that and you'll get to
the RUIN VALLEY.

entries.SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_I:
Fufu… Fufufufu…
I guessed right.

I was right in tailing you!
entries.SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_S:
I knew that there was a SAPPHIRE
here, so it belongs to me!

I'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for
serious money.

…D-don't glare at me like that!

If you want it back, why don't you
go get it after I sell it?

I'll even tell you one of the
passwords to TEAM ROCKET's
WAREHOUSE.

The WAREHOUSE password I know is
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”

I'm done.
Don't think badly of me!

entries.SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynIntro:
…Huh?

I was envisioning my house, but
this is where I TELEPORT?
entries.SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynPostBattl:
I am so scatterbrained!

I need to focus so I can TELEPORT
properly to my house!
entries.SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_RightRouteSign:
GREEN PATH
Think Green, Keep Nature Clean!

entries.SixIsland_House_Text_GoodPlaceForNatureA:
There's nothing that young people'd
find exciting here on this island.

But, this is a good place in terms
of nature and history.

Relax and enjoy your stay.

entries.SixIsland_Mart_Text_AgathaOldestEverElit:
Play with POKéMON lots and live
a long life!

Take AGATHA, for example.

She set a record for being the
oldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.

She spurs me to do bigger things.
entries.SixIsland_Mart_Text_ShouldBuyMailAndWrit:
I should buy some MAIL and write
him a letter…

entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaDefeat:
AVA: Oh, you're amazing!
Even better, you're on your own!
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaIntro:
AVA: Let's have a two-on-two
marine battle!
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaNotEnoug:
AVA: You're challenging us to
a battle?

You'll need at least two POKéMON
if you want to do that.
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaPostBatt:
AVA: You know, I do prefer the
sea over any pool.
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebDefeat:
GEB: Wow, Big Sister, this person's
really good!
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebIntro:
GEB: Big Sister, help!
Please battle with me!
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebNotEnoug:
GEB: Please battle against me and
my sister!

…Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebPostBatt:
GEB: I'm hanging onto my sister
because I can't touch the bottom.
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoIntro:
Gasp… Gasp…

I swam here from SIX ISLE PORT
in one go.
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoPostBat:
I'm only at the halfway point…
I'm beat…
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleDefea:
I didn't lose to you at swimming.
This doesn't bother me.
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleIntro:
It's not so easy sending POKéMON
out while swimming, you know?
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicolePostB:
Are you headed for the island up
past here?

I didn't see anything interesting
there.
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketIntro:
There're no rare POKéMON around
these parts! Not a one!

That burns me up, man.
I'll take it out on you!
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketPostB:
So listen, you haven't seen any
rare POKéMON, have you?
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorIntro:
I'm having no luck at all.
A battle'd be a change of pace!
entries.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorPostBa:
I can't very well go home without
catching something, though.

entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonDefeat:
Oh, for someone so young, you are
tremendous!
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonIntro:
I'm working to preserve the natural
ecology of POKéMON here.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonPostBa:
I'm not saying that you shouldn't
catch POKéMON.

I just want people to raise their
POKéMON responsibly.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyDefeat:
You raise your POKéMON with a
whole lot of love!
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyIntro:
I'm curious, how do you raise your
POKéMON?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyPostBa:
In the same way your mother raised
you full of love, you should raise
your POKéMON.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellDefeat:
I bet you think I'm weak,
don't you, eh?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellIntro:
I bet you think I'm just some guy,
don't you, eh?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellPostBa:
Ayup, you townies come around all
so dandy with a hat that flashy…

How about giving me that?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaDefeat:
If you'd like, I can teach you how
to breathe properly.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaIntro:
Take a deep breath.
Isn't the air delicious?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaPostBatt:
First, exhale.
Blow everything out.

When you can't exhale anymore,
inhale the clean air!

Isn't it refreshing?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretIntro:
I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives
only around here!
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretPostBat:
There's a girl near the BUSH who
measures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaDefeat:
I lost, but I'm still laughing.
Am I the only girl like that?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaIntro:
I love BUG POKéMON.
That's why I'm here all the time.

Am I the only girl like that?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaPostBatt:
I'm going to keep on collecting
BUG POKéMON.

Am I the only girl like that?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahDefeat:
It's okay, losing is a fun part of
POKéMON's appeal, too.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahIntro:
You know, it just doesn't feel right
if I don't use BUG POKéMON.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahPostBatt:
By the way, “appeal” is a weird
word, if you think about it.

Like, is it like an orange peel?
Or like a ringing bell?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonDefeat:
Have you taken a good look around
your feet?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonIntro:
Have you noticed something odd
about these parts?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonPostBat:
There are places here in PATTERN
BUSH where grass won't grow.

What could be the cause of such
a phenomenon?
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyDefeat:
It wasn't a bug.
I cut my shin on some grass.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyIntro:
Oh, yuck!
I think a bug stung me!
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyPostBatt:
A little cut like that…
A little spit's enough to cure it!
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashIntro:
Look, look! There are funny
patterns on the ground.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashPostBattl:
The funny patterns on the ground…

They look like the patterns on my
grandpa's clothes.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyIntro:
This is a good spot.
I'll pitch my tent here.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyPostBatt:
I'm going to observe the night sky
here.
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceDefeat:
I got beat while I was still busy
celebrating!
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceIntro:
Yeah, yeah, yeah!
Look at all the BUG POKéMON!
entries.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VancePostBatt:
I'm going to bring my little brother
here next time.

entries.SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomeMons:
You know of POKéMON that evolve
only upon trading, yes?

But did you know that there are
still others?

Some POKéMON evolve only when
traded while holding specific items.
entries.SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Somethin:
For ten years, I've searched for
RUINS.

No, make that twenty years.

I get this feeling that there's
something hidden on this island.

entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CantFigureOutH:
I can't figure out how I'm supposed
to get inside.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CheckDoorMoreT:
The door doesn't budge at all.
Check it more thoroughly?
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylDefeat:
Oh, the heartbreak of losing so
easily to you!
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylIntro: A battle with you, so high up!
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterDefeat:
It's been so long since I battled,
my instincts are off.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterIntro:
I'm curious, what compelled you to
come here?
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterPostBatt:
There are several ruins on the
SEVII ISLANDS.

The majority of them date back
a long way.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorDefeat:
You don't need to be so pushy.
I'll be happy to tell you.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorIntro:
I'm pretty familiar with the land
around these parts.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorPostBatt:
The door to the ruins…
It has these strange patterns
engraved on the outside.

I don't know what they mean,
though.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_IFoundThisPlac:
Let me tell you, I found this
place.

Don't look so envious, will you?
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryIntro:
It's been said that there are
mysterious stones on this island.

I suspect it has something to do
with the ruins here.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryPostBattl:
Those ruins over there…

I haven't had any luck in finding
how I can get inside.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_SeveralDotsOnT:
On closer inspection, there are
several dots on the door…
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyIntro:
There appear to be many secrets
still unsolved in this world.
entries.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyPostBatt:
I suggest to you that you, too,
give a thought to the secrets and
mysteries of our world once a day.

entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseDefeat: Awww, I knew this would happen!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseIntro:
My boyfriend's always busy, so I
come swimming by myself.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DenisePostBattl:
When I can't be with my boyfriend,
I spend time with the POKéMON he
gave me.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlDefeat:
I lost my way while I was busy
battling!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlIntro:
Tell me, where are the mountains
around these parts?
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlPostBattle:
Aren't there any mountains around
these parts?
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardIntro:
I'm practicing in secret so no one
can see me.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardPostBattl:
As a performer, I don't want people
to know about the effort I put in.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaDefeat:
MIA: You're mean!
You're bad for winning!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaIntro:
MIA: Hello, POKéMON!
It's time to battle!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaNotEnoughMon:
MIA: Oh, you only have one
POKéMON?

Don't you feel lonesome?
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaPostBattle:
MIA: Ohh…
I'm sorry, my POKéMON…
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuIntro:
MIU: Hello, POKéMON!
It's time to play!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuNotEnoughMon:
MIU: MIA and I are TWINS.
We want to battle together.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuPostBattle:
MIU: It makes me all sad inside
when we lose…
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseDefeat:
Giggle… You're so cute when you're
determined.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseIntro:
I let a pleasant breeze lead me
all the way here.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RosePostBattle:
I want to go to the woods over
there, but…

There are lots of BUG POKéMON.
They scare me a little.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RouteSign:
WATER PATH
Leads to RUIN VALLEY
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirIntro:
What, you're suggesting that you're
sick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?

Aww, don't be hatin'!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirPostBattle:
I couldn't lift the stigma of being
a SWIMMER…

entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestH:
The biggest HERACROSS that I have
ever seen measured so far is:

{STR_VAR_3} inches!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankCha:
It's a blank chart of some sort.

It has spaces for writing in
records of some kind.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch:
Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2} inches!
I've never seen anything like this!
You deserve a reward!

Huh? This {STR_VAR_2}-inch measurement…
Oh, boo! It's the same as before.

Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2} inches.
The HERACROSS before was bigger.

It was {STR_VAR_3} inches, the biggest
HERACROSS you've brought me.
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNe:
Hera, hera, HERACROSS!
Big and shiny, it's the bug boss!
Love it, need it, HERACROSS!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeas:
Eeeeek!
That's a HERACROSS!

Please, please, may I measure how
big it is?
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWont:
Oh, no! This won't do!

HERACROSS looks much more macho
and cool, and has a lovely horn!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSe:
I want to see a much, much bigger
HERACROSS than that one.

Oh, how I adore them, big
HERACROSS!
entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagI:
Your BAG is full.
My reward won't fit.

entries.SixIsland_WaterPath_House2_Text_MyNeighb:
My height is 67.0 inches on the
button.

I know it is this precisely because
my neighbor measured me.

entries.ThreeIsland_Text_BossIsOnHisWay:
Hey, go cry somewhere else.
Our boss is on his way.

When he gets here, we'll give you
a k-rad motorbike show you won't
soon forget!
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_GetOffIslandNow:
W-what!? Not on your life!
Get off the island now!
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_GoBackToKanto:
We don't need you people bringing
your noise and trouble here!

We're asking you to go back to
KANTO!
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_IslandBelongsToUs:
Hyahoo!

From this day on, this island
belongs to us!
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_IslandSign:
THREE ISLAND
Kin Island of Family Bonding
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_LostelleWentOffTowardsB:
It'd be fantastic if someone as
strong as you lived here.

I hope you'll at least stay here
a while.

…I beg your pardon?
You're looking for LOSTELLE?

LOSTELLE went off towards BOND
BRIDGE a while ago.
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_ThankYouOhYourMonGotHur:
Thank you! Those goons were
nothing but bad trouble.

Oh, look, your POKéMON got hurt
on my account.
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_WhenDodouEvolvesGoingTo:
I'm going to train my DODUO in the
BERRY FOREST.

When it evolves, I'm going to play
a game on TWO ISLAND.
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_WouldntWantToSeeBikersH:
THREE ISLAND is actually the most
populous of the islands here.

Still, it could be less sleepy.

But I wouldn't want to see goons
like those BIKERS here again.
entries.ThreeIsland_Text_YouveGotImpressiveMons:
You've got seriously impressive
POKéMON with you.

entries.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchI:
Your BERRY POUCH is full.
I guess you don't want this.
entries.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPo:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!

A scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.

It kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.

I'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…
entries.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComes:
Oh! Here it comes again!
No! Go away! It's scaring me!

Waaaaaaah!
I want my daddy!
entries.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome:
What's your name?

LOSTELLE's scared, so can I go
with you to my daddy's house?

Okay!
Let's go home!
entries.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHav:
Ohh! That was so scary!
Thank you!

LOSTELLE came to pick some
BERRIES.

You can have this!
entries.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_WelcomeToBe:
Welcome to the BERRY FOREST

Be friendly and share BERRIES with
others and POKéMON.

entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBa:
Did I just win?
Or did I lose?
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro:
My mommy said that I can't swim
without my float ring.
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBat:
This year, I'm going to finally
learn how to swim!
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSi:
BOND BRIDGE
Please be quiet when crossing.

BERRY FOREST AHEAD
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro:
JOY: We'll teach you what our
favorite POKéMON is!
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnough:
JOY: I really want to battle with
MEG.

One POKéMON isn't enough.
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattl:
JOY: Wasn't that fun?
I hope we can battle again!
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro:
MEG: We'll show you our favorite
POKéMON.
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnough:
MEG: I want to battle together
with JOY.

One POKéMON isn't enough.
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro:
The salty tang of the sea…
It tickles my heart.
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBat:
Perhaps that reek is your sweaty
POKéMON's body odor…
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat:
Okay, you've won!
Now will you please go away?
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro:
Oh, no, don't come here!
Please, stay away from me!
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBat:
A POKéMON bit through my 
swimsuit.

I can't get out of the water!
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro:
Where are you off to in such
a hurry?
entries.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBa:
If you keep going this way, you'll
eventually reach BERRY FOREST.

entries.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_Prospec:
Hey, there!
How's it going?

What am I doing here, you ask?
Why, I'm prospecting for gold!

When I strike it rich, I'm buying
a house in KANTO.
entries.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckG:
Hey, there! How's it going?
Did you hear? I've struck gold!

You remembered that I was
prospecting, didn't you?

You can't begin to imagine just
how happy I am.

So, I'll show you!
This is for you!
entries.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsAN:
That's a NUGGET!

I can't give you any nuggets of
wisdom, so that'll have to do!
entries.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsB:
Whoops, your BAG is crammed full!
I'll give this to you later.

entries.ThreeIsland_House1_Text_RareRocksGemsDis: Rare rocks and gems are displayed.
entries.ThreeIsland_House1_Text_YoureAlwaysSoCoo:
LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}!
You're always so cool!

I'll make lunch for you, too, one
day, {PLAYER}.

entries.ThreeIsland_House2_Text_CantMakeThisSpoo:
Urrrrrrrrgggghhhh…
Kwaaaaah!

…It's useless! I can't make this
spoon bend with my mind.

Maybe I really don't have any
psychic powers.
entries.ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER
in SAFFRON CITY?

She uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,
right?

I admire her, I really do.

I've heard that she's one cool
customer and beautiful, too.

entries.ThreeIsland_House3_Text_WantedToLiveSome:
I bought this house because I
wanted to live somewhere quiet.

Today, I think I'll go out fishing.

entries.ThreeIsland_House4_Text_GhostsInBerryFor:
You must never, ever go out to
the BERRY FOREST alone.

Why?
There are ghosts there.
entries.ThreeIsland_House4_Text_PapaKeepsLyingTo:
Papa keeps lying to me, and won't
let me go out and play!

entries.ThreeIsland_House5_Text_IllGoPlayWithLos:
I think I'll go play with LOSTELLE
today.
entries.ThreeIsland_House5_Text_ImNotLostelle:
Me?
I'm not LOSTELLE.

She's probably gone to the
BERRY FOREST, I think.

She picks BERRIES there for making
lunch.

entries.ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_BikersWereAboutToT:
Those BIKERS were about to trash
this POKéMON MART.

Am I glad they decided to leave!
entries.ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_PeopleHealWithBerr:
I sometimes buy medicine here.

But a lot of people heal POKéMON
with BERRIES from BERRY FOREST.

After all, BERRIES are free and
they never run out.
entries.ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_TrueThatCeldadonDe:
Is it true?

CELADON DEPT. STORE is several
times bigger than this shop?

entries.ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Always:
Let's crush BERRIES!
…That'd be wasting BERRIES?

You can always find some BERRIES
on the ground in BERRY FOREST.
entries.ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Imposs:
It's impossible to SURF between the
islands around these parts.

The tides are too fast and
treacherous.
entries.ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetw:
Hey, did you hear the news?

The PC network here can now link
with PCs in KANTO.

I don't know how that came about,
but it's fantastic!

entries.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOu:
Those BIKERS ran off, and
LOSTELLE was found safe.

Everything turned out for the best!
entries.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney:
Hey, hey, lady!
Fork over some spending money!
entries.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice:
Aiyeeh!

Wh-who are you?!
I… I'll call the police!
entries.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBiker:
Those BIKERS…
Are they gone?

Oh, thank goodness!
They certainly had me terrified!
entries.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFede:
We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!
Vroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!

My bike's wimpy, so I have to
make exhaust noises myself!

entries.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_GiveItYourBest: I hope you give it your best.
entries.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StairsTougherTha:
Gasp, gasp…
Gasp…

Never mind battling! These stairs…
They're tougher than any battle…
entries.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WonderWhatKindsO:
I'm here to see how good I am.

I wonder what kinds of TRAINERS
are waiting for me?

It's nerve-racking!
entries.TrainerTower_Roof_Text_IdLikeToSeeBetter:
What I would like to see is a
better time out of you…

I'm counting on you.

Until then, farewell…
entries.TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ImOwnerBattledPer:
Hello…

I am the owner of this TOWER…

How the sky soars above this
rooftop…

The caress of the winds up here…

It's all so perfect…

The way you battled…
It, too, was perfection…

entries.TwoIsland_Text_AddedMerchandiseForLostel:
I can't tell you how grateful I am
for your rescue of LOSTELLE.

Thanks to your feat, the people of
THREE ISLAND have changed their
attitudes about KANTO people.

And, I'm from KANTO, you see.

The people of THREE ISLAND
helped me add to my merchandise.
entries.TwoIsland_Text_BringingItemsFromDistantL:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
Welcome!

I've started bringing in items from
distant lands.

I've got some rare items in, too.
Please have a look!
entries.TwoIsland_Text_BrunoCameToIslandWhileBac:
Listen, listen.
Did you know?

A famous TRAINER came to the
ISLAND a little while back.

He's one of the ELITE FOUR.
His name is BRUNO.

He went away disappointed when he
found out that they were all sold
out of Rage Candybars.
entries.TwoIsland_Text_BuyRareItemsHere:
The discerning TRAINER knows to
buy rare items here!
entries.TwoIsland_Text_DangerFastCurrent:
DANGER! FAST CURRENT!
Fishing and surfing prohibited!
entries.TwoIsland_Text_FellowMovedFromCeladonCit:
That fellow there, he moved here
from CELADON CITY.

He started up a shop with his
younger brother.

You have to wonder if he knew what
he was getting into.
entries.TwoIsland_Text_HaveYouTriedJumpingGame:
Boing! Boing!
Have you tried the jumping game?

The POKéMON you can enter…
Boing!

Some go boing!

And some go boooooooing!

Did you know that?
Boing!
entries.TwoIsland_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest:
Hi! I'm giving it my best here.
I hope you do too, {PLAYER}.
entries.TwoIsland_Text_IslandSign:
TWO ISLAND
Boon Island for Two
entries.TwoIsland_Text_OldWomanLivesOutOnCape:
There's an old woman who lives in
a cottage out on the cape.

She gives the eye to POKéMON.
It's a bit unnerving.
entries.TwoIsland_Text_ShopkeepersBrotherWorksGa:
The shopkeeper's brother took
a job at the GAME CORNER.

He's trying to pull together money
so they can buy more merchandise.
entries.TwoIsland_Text_WelcomeToShopMerchandiseL:
Oh!
Hello, welcome to my shop!

We've only opened up recently.

Our merchandise is limited, but I
hope we can serve your needs.

entries.Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove:
Oh! This is the one!
This is the POKéMON!

This {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of
learning my ultimate move!

Will you allow it?

Will you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to
learn my {STR_VAR_2}?
entries.Text_FeelRejuvenated:
After I passed on my knowledge to
you, I felt so much relief.

In fact, I feel rejuvenated,
as if I were younger again!
entries.Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove:
You will allow it?

Then, let me confer my ultimate
{STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.

Ggggrah-awooo!
entries.Text_MakeBestUseOfMove:
I implore you to make the best
use of that move and gain power!
entries.Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow:
Gasp, gasp, gasp…

I have no regrets now.
I've passed on everything I know.

Now I can live out my life knowing
my work is done.
entries.Text_TaughtMove:
Gasp, gasp, gasp…

I didn't think I could teach that
move while I still lived…
entries.Text_UltimateMoveThatMon:
I perfected the ultimate move of
its type…

But will no one take it for
future use?

…Hm? Hmmm!

Y-you…
Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…
entries.Text_YouRejectIt:
Gaah! You reject it?
No, I won't be dissuaded!

entries.TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoTo:
If your POKéMON need to learn a
move, I need a MUSHROOM or two.
entries.TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMush:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.

I know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.

I'm also a mushroom maniac.

Bring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.

If you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.
entries.TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove:
Sniff, sniff…
Hm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!

Do you want me to teach a move
to a POKéMON of yours?

entries.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_GetGames:
We'll get the games going soon
for you!
entries.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_HandedMe:
{PLAYER} handed the METEORITE
to LOSTELLE's daddy.
entries.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IllGetGa:

the UNION ROOM.

chat, battle, and trade.

the DIRECT CORNER.

Communication System.
